proposal.observation: ZN-E018 (frozen ZN-E010 + P0c, split 2021): MAPE 0.3254, Acc@15 0.3185, RMSE 445.2, P0c violation 0.149 -> 0.055 (-63%). User decision A6-ZN: confirm this physics-informed variant on all paper splits. Matched no-physics run on split 42: ZN-E013.
proposal.primary_hypothesis: On split 42 the P0c loss again cuts the held-out P0c violation >= 50% vs ZN-E013 at about equal accuracy, so the 3-split physics-consistency result holds.
proposal.question_inherited: Is the P0c physics-consistency gain reproducible on the other paper splits?
proposal.unresolved_from_reference: Split dependence of the P0c effect (violation and accuracy) on split 42.
proposal.why_this_experiment: User decision A6-ZN (2026-11-13): 3-split confirmation of the P0c variant for the thesis physics-informed row; state.json split_protocol.
proposal.modification: None vs ZN-E018: identical model, loss (P0c, rho 0.5, lambda recalibrated on this split's train batches by the same rule) and training; only BL_SPLIT=42.
proposal.changed_components: Data split only (BL_SPLIT=42); lambda is re-calibrated by the fixed loss.md §5.2 rule on this split.
proposal.held_constant_components: Frozen ZN-E010 architecture (98,113 params, GELU, anchored fade encoder), Relative Huber delta 0.15 main loss, Adam lr 5e-4, batch 128, seed 2021, split 2021, A2-ZN epochs, checkpoint rule, data.
proposal.controlled_variables: Training seed 2021, A2-ZN epochs, rho 0.5, alpha_max from this split's train cells. Sole changed variable: split 42.
proposal.expected_evidence: Split-42 MAPE/Acc@15/RMSE/DB-MAPE, held-out P0c violation vs ZN-E013, lambda, loss balance, gradient health; contributes to the 3-split aggregate.
proposal.rejection_condition: Per-run disposition: VALID (finite, protocol, completeness) -> KEEP as physics-consistency confirmation evidence; protocol/finite/completeness failure -> INVALID, no decision. Aggregate (after ZN-E020, over ZN-E018/E019/E020 = splits 2021/42/2024 vs the ZN-E010 config on the same splits ZN-E010/E013/E014): the P0c variant is CONFIRMED as physics-informed iff (a) on every split the held-out P0c violation rate (alpha = alpha_max) falls >= 50% vs the ZN-E010-config run on that split, or stays <= 0.01 where that reference is already 0 (reference rates: 2021 0.149, 42 0.000, 2024 0.0825; diagnostics/ZN-E013_E014_p0c_violations.md), AND (b) 3-split mean MAPE <= 0.342 (ZN-E010 3-split 0.332 + 0.010) AND mean Acc@15 >= 0.294 (0.324 - 0.030) AND 3-split mean MAPE < 0.515 (paper CPTransformer). If CONFIRMED it is reported as the physics-informed companion of ZN-E010 (loss.md §4.6 claim rule); ZN-E010 stays the accuracy model unless the P0c 3-split mean is better on both MAPE and Acc@15. Phase 2 then closes (A6-ZN).
proposal.minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
proposal.required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; cycle_stem, residual_blocks, fade_encoder, inter_summary and head gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain and EOL errors; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, throughput. Loss balance: lambda2, R_j median, cosine, active fraction (loss.md §5.3).
